question: Restore choice selection inside Remote task messages without turning closed choices into free-text forms.

official_observations.conclusion: Selection removes the per-question custom draft, clears current text, stores a one-element array containing the option label verbatim under question ID. Multiple questions call progression0x1a56654; one question invokes submit closure at view+0xb0 directly.
Indicator compares the first stored answer with the row label. Duplicate labels can share selection indication; they must not be deduplicated as one option.
Custom footer exists when isOther is true or the options array count is zero. Closed nonempty choices omit the footer.

PlainButtonStyle; firstTextBaseline HStack spacing10; label/description VStack spacing4; body primary label and nonempty callout secondary description; selected checkmark-lg with caption and secondary color.

Bounded previous/next index changes do not require current question to be answered. Index-change callback reads customAnswersByQuestionID to restore unsent custom text. Not integrated yet; writer/focus and exact lifecycle remain unresolved.

changes: Choice dispatch and custom-input visibility integrated into RemoteUserInputDraft and RecoveredRemoteUserInputForm.
Enumerated row identity retains duplicate labels. Existing free/secret fixture remains; --remote-user-input-fixture=choices adds two synthetic closed/other-enabled questions.
Chat/Work confirmed still title=nil and only empty-home mode selector; no independent debug title route.

UI retains partial parent layout and unspecified row padding/material. Previous/next navigation and custom draft restoration are not integrated.
